what: server-side, no launcher part: the hosted MCP access (#3363) - an MCP client connects to the server itself at /mcp with OAuth 2.1 (authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration) and gets the rights of the agent a person picks on the consent page; the tools are the ones of mcp/kalmido_mcp.py, run by the server.
